caveats: PRICING-BASIS MIX: some members transact at NAV, others at exchange market price. Return comparisons mix appraisal dynamics with premium/discount dynamics, so composites across this line are refused, not averaged. [per product from the record: ARK Venture Fund: NAV, Destiny Tech100 Inc: market price, Neostellar Capital Corp.: market price]

LEVERAGE-REGIME MIX: BDC 150% coverage and non-1940-Act wrappers allow materially more leverage than 1940-Act funds. Fee bases and return volatility are not like-for-like. [per product from the record: ARK Venture Fund: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, Destiny Tech100 Inc: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, Neostellar Capital Corp.: BDC 150% asset-coverage regime]

LIQUIDITY-LAW MIX: Rule 23c-3 obligations, discretionary tenders, and repurchase plans give different worst-case exit rights. Cadence numbers alone overstate comparability. [by wrapper type: ARK Venture Fund: Rule 23c-3 OBLIGATION (board cannot skip a window), Destiny Tech100 Inc: continuous exchange dealing, Neostellar Capital Corp.: continuous exchange dealing]

NAV-CADENCE MIX: daily, monthly, and quarterly NAV processes embed different appraisal smoothing. Volatility and drawdown comparisons inherit that difference (see de-smoothing lab). [per product from the record: ARK Venture Fund: daily, Destiny Tech100 Inc: quarterly, Neostellar Capital Corp.: quarterly]

composite.reason: members' pricing bases are heterogeneous (market price vs NAV). An equal-weight composite would average premium/discount dynamics against appraisal NAVs, so it is refused, not fudged

cohort.label: Pre-IPO / venture growth (listed CEF + listed BDC + interval fund)

arkvx.membership_rationale: Interval fund holding venture/growth, the NAV-priced contrast to the two market-priced members. Pricing-basis mix is the cohort's disclosed core caveat (composite refused).

dxyz.membership_rationale: Listed CEF holding pre-IPO tech, the premium-pricing fail case. The cohort exists to show premium vs NAV pricing as a PATTERN.

ssss.membership_rationale: Listed BDC (fka SuRo Capital) holding late-stage growth equity, the second market-priced venture vehicle. Gives dxyz a premium/discount comparable. Membership CONDITIONAL on strategy continuity through the Neostellar rename (verification queue).
